exit_reason_interpretation.meaning: Android records termination by the system low-memory killer under system memory pressure.
exit_reason_interpretation.name: REASON_LOW_MEMORY

interpretation_limits: The last small Java/native heap checkpoint does not measure the later peak or system-wide pressure.
ApplicationExitInfo RSS/PSS are recorded sampled process statistics, not proof of peak allocation at the kill.
No system available-memory, threshold, I/O guard metrics or current asset name were persisted in this supplied checkpoint.
The cumulative 1152 MiB copied value localizes a boundary but does not prove that a particular asset caused the kill.
No Game, GPU-startup, movement, saving or FPS test was reached; completed .21 GPU milestones remain intact.
The selected installer mitigation requires physical setup confirmation and does not establish an FPS gain.
